The main takeaway from our work is that
deuteron activation of nat Re is an excellent alternative to proton activation for the production of the 185 Os and 183 Re radionuclides for medical applications.
deuteron induced reactions on rhenum are very useful for activation analysis and nuclear medicine applications.
the ALICE-3 and EMPIRE codes can be successfully applied for deuteron-induced reaction calculations.
